privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AutoCommunity is a social platform for drivers in Kazakhstan. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, how long we keep it and what control you have over it.

controller.title: Who processes your data
controller.body: The operator of AutoCommunity processes your personal data as the owner and operator of the personal-data database within the meaning of the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan "On Personal Data and Their Protection". Operator details will be published here before launch.

data.title: What we collect
data.body:
Account data: phone number (or the identifier from Google / Apple if you sign in with them), name, nickname, city, a short bio and an optional profile photo. Photos are re-encoded on upload and their EXIF metadata (including GPS tags) is removed.

Car data: brand, model, year and, if you add it, the licence plate.

Technical data: the device and browser used to sign in, IP address (for security and rate limits) and the time of your last activity.

location.title: Geolocation
location.body:
We use your location only with your explicit consent, which you give during sign-up and can withdraw at any time by switching to Hidden mode or blocking location access in your browser.

Location is used to show you on the drivers' map according to the privacy mode you choose (Hidden, My communities, Friends, Everyone), to deliver SOS alerts about drivers nearby who need help, and to send your own SOS to the nearest drivers.

In Everyone mode other drivers see only an approximate position, rounded to about 500 m. In Hidden mode nobody sees your location, but you can still receive SOS alerts if you have turned them on.

plates.title: Licence plates
plates.body: Your licence plate is never shown on the map. It is visible only to you and to drivers you have added as friends, on your profile.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: We store only your latest position, not a history of your movements. A position older than 15 minutes is no longer shown to anyone. Account data is kept while your account exists. When you delete your account, your profile is anonymised and your location, cars, photos, friendships and sessions are deleted immediately.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.body: We do not sell personal data. We use service providers strictly to run the service: hosting, file storage and SMS delivery. Other users see only what your privacy settings allow.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can view and correct your data in your profile, change who sees your location in Settings, withdraw consent to geolocation, and delete your account in Settings at any time. You can also contact us to request a copy of your data.

law.title: Applicable law
law.body: Personal data is processed in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V of 21 May 2013 "On Personal Data and Their Protection", including its requirements on consent and on storing personal data of citizens of Kazakhstan in databases located in Kazakhstan.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about personal data can be sent to the operator's support address, which will be published here before launch.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of AutoCommunity. By creating an account you accept them.

acceptance.title: Accepting the terms
acceptance.body: You must be at least 18 years old and hold the right to drive a vehicle to use the service. One person may have one account.

service.title: What the service is
service.body: AutoCommunity connects drivers: a map of drivers nearby, car communities, chats and requests for help on the road (SOS) from other users who volunteer to help.

emergency.title: Not an emergency service
emergency.body: AutoCommunity does not replace emergency services. Help from other users is voluntary and is not guaranteed. If anyone is injured, in danger, or there is a road accident or fire, call 112 (or 103 for an ambulance) first.

conduct.title: Your conduct
conduct.body: Do not create fake SOS requests, harass other users, impersonate others, share other people's personal data or post illegal content. Breaking these rules lowers your trust rating and may lead to warnings or a block.

rating.title: Trust rating
rating.body: Every account starts with a trust rating of 50 out of 100. It grows when you help others and receive good reviews, and drops after confirmed reports. Some features, such as responding to SOS, require a minimum rating.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Users act at their own risk when giving or receiving help. The platform is not a party to agreements between users and is not responsible for their actions, to the extent permitted by law.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You can delete your account at any time in Settings. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

law.title: Applicable law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We will notify you in the app before material changes to these terms take effect.
